title: 碛中作
author: 岑参
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE full-bleed 9:16 portrait illustration for a premium Chinese poetry reader. Refined traditional Chinese ink with delicate translucent watercolor on warm ivory xuan paper, restrained celadon, soft ochre and ink grey, naturally textured brushwork, airy lyrical depth. Tang-era clothing, architecture and objects if relevant. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: main subjects are confined to the TOP 25–30% of the tall sheet, softly dissolving into ivory mist by 33% height. The central and lower 65% must be almost blank warm ivory writing paper for separately rendered poem text. All four paper edges are full bleed: no frame, rectangular picture boundary, green outer border, UI, collage, modern objects, written characters, title, calligraphy, stamp, seal, logo or watermark. Specific scene: A small lone mounted traveler crossing immense level pale desert under a full moon, distant horizons merging with the sky, no inns or settlements. Strong feeling of vastness without a violent sandstorm.
Poem (semantic reference only, do not paint words): 碛中作 — 岑参
走马西来欲到天，辞家见月两回圆。
今夜不知何处宿，平沙万里绝人烟。
